At most «технически импортировано»; no art acceptance, no budget (GD-058 open); team colours Blue/Red are a diagnostic pair (Q-304 open).

candidate.textures_note: 2K runtime set only (committed); the 4K masters stay local and are never imported. TeamMaskRGBA (R cloth, G base band, B embroidery) is not imported: M_UM_Figure reads TeamMask.R, the base band of M_UM_BaseMarker comes from the side-wall normal (W4-B)

conventions_required.ORM: R = AO, G = roughness, B = metallic

armature.bones_note: UM_HUMANOID_17_v2: 16 body bones + weapon.R (Merlin's staff, rigid 100 %). In UE the armature object SKEL_UM_Humanoid becomes bone 0 (18 bones), '.' becomes '_' (weapon_R)

scale.note: hood top 45.0 uu above the base bottom (bake measures.hood_top_uu 44.986); the staff crystal is the skeletal top (49.42 uu), not the figure height

axes.expected_ue_front_source: 04-blender-production.md §1 «Оси» + §1.1 preset UM_FBX_v1 (ART-001); the bake measured the face +3.4 uu ahead of the body centroid along +X in the export frame

sockets.name: Weapon
sockets.purpose: rig-contract §7: Weapon on the weapon bone at (0,0,0) = the grip on the staff axis

sockets.name: Head
sockets.purpose: damage / status VFX; location = the bake's UE bone-space prediction (face part bbox centre)

sockets_note: StaffTip (crystal centre, AD-CNF-59 open) stays a proposal in the bake report and is not created in UE

expectations.note: numbers of the H2.1 bake (build-report.json of merlin-h2-bake/2); the FBX carries LOD0 only

proposed_limits_for_comparison_only.source: bake profile budget_proposal (figure 30-45 k tris, 4K master + 2K runtime, <= 2 slots) and 04 §3.4 — ПРЕДЛОЖЕНИЕ до решения GD-058, не бюджет

ue.teams_note: diagnostic pair for the W5c frames (task: TeamColor blue and red); С-11 Gold/Silver stays the palette proposal (Q-304 open). Linear only through FLinearColor::FromSRGBColor (AD-OPEN-39 rule). Proposal
ue.team_color_mode_note: user decision 2026-09-28 (AD-CNF-58 = b): TeamColor on the clothing by TeamMask.R (H2.1 mask: robe with hood 0.82, sleeves 0.87-0.89; skin, face, staff, crystal, shoes 0) and on the base side band
ue.figure_parameters_note: as W4-B: the dark blue cloth is dyed (TeamColor x luminance(BC) x TeamDyeGain). Gain 5.5 kept: measured H2.1 cloth luminance (TeamMask >= 0.5, linear BC 2K) 0.0263 vs 0.0269 of the W4-B atlas, so the Medusa-matched gain would be 0.147 / 0.0263 = 5.58 (+1.5 %). RoughnessMin/Max, NormalStrength, AOToBaseColor stay neutral (bake report 11.4: the H2.1 roughness classes must not shift). Proposal

base_marker.note: textured H2 base (24 x 24 x 5 uu, same atlas): team band = the side wall (|n.z| < SideBandNormalZMax), flat TeamColor; as W4-B. Proposal

N.note: DirectX normal of the bake (green of the OpenGL bake inverted); no OpenGL copy exists and none is imported

ORM.note: R AO, G roughness, B metallic, linear; TC_Masks keeps the three channels independent (no sRGB curve)

TeamMask.note: single-channel L8 mask: TC_Grayscale stores it uncompressed (G8), no channel is lost; M_UM_Figure samples it as LinearGrayscale (W4-B)
